style: Isometric low-poly 3D diorama floating as a small rounded island on a plain solid deep navy #0F1B3D background with a soft teal glow beneath it. Soft matte clay 3D render, rounded toy-model shapes, gentle warm studio lighting mixed with soft teal glow from screens and light strips, soft long shadows, tilt-shift miniature look. Cohesive color palette of royal blue #264FBB, bright teal #31DDB0, soft white #F4F7FB, warm sand #F2C57C, coral #FF8A65 and deep navy #0F1B3D. The only characters are tiny friendly rounded robots and simple faceless toy figurines. Highly detailed, centered composition with the island filling the middle of the frame, wide 16:9 landscape framing, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.

sections.label: Rumah
sections.subject: a cozy two-storey miniature smart home cut open like a dollhouse at sunrise: a coffee machine pouring coffee by itself, a small robot vacuum gliding across the wooden floor, curtains opening automatically, warm lamps fading on, a smart speaker glowing teal on the kitchen counter, a faceless toy figurine stretching by the window
sections.focal: the kitchen counter where the coffee machine pours coffee
sections.eyebrow: AI & automation, dari rumah sampai bisnis
sections.title: Biar mesin yang repot.
sections.body: Mulai dari rumah: lampu, kopi, dan jadwal pagi sudah siap sebelum kamu sempat membuka HP.

sections.label: Asisten
sections.subject: a miniature home office desk island where small friendly robots sort floating paper envelopes into neat colored trays, a calendar board with colored sticky notes rearranging itself, a laptop glowing teal, a tiny conveyor sending finished letters out through a mail chute
sections.focal: the robots sorting envelopes into trays
sections.title: Inbox beres tanpa drama.
sections.body: AI membaca, memilah, dan menyiapkan draf balasan, jadi kamu cukup menyetujui yang memang penting.

sections.label: Keuangan
sections.subject: a miniature personal finance vault island: a big round clay piggy bank, little robots stacking golden coins into glass jars, a small machine sliding paper bills into a mailbox to pay them, a glowing tablet showing simple bar charts made of colored blocks
sections.focal: the robots stacking coins into the jars
sections.title: Uang yang tertata sendiri.
sections.body: Tagihan terbayar tepat waktu, pengeluaran tercatat otomatis, dan tabungan jalan tanpa harus diingat-ingat.

sections.label: Kesehatan
sections.subject: a miniature wellness park island with a looping running track, a small clinic pavilion, a giant smartwatch sculpture glowing teal with a heartbeat line, a faceless toy figurine jogging, a tiny robot holding out a water bottle, a stall with colorful fruit
sections.focal: the giant glowing smartwatch sculpture
sections.title: Badan dipantau, bukan ditebak.
sections.body: Wearable dan AI membaca pola tidur, langkah, serta detak jantung, lalu mengingatkan sebelum masalah kecil membesar.

sections.label: Belajar
sections.subject: a miniature cozy library learning pod island: tall stacks of colorful books, a faceless toy figurine student at a desk with a glowing laptop, a friendly hologram tutor robot pointing at a floating chalkboard with simple geometric shapes, little paper planes gliding around
sections.focal: the student desk and the hologram tutor robot
sections.title: Tutor yang tidak pernah lelah.
sections.body: AI menjelaskan ulang materi dengan cara yang paling kamu pahami, kapan pun kamu siap belajar.

sections.label: Mobilitas
sections.subject: a miniature city intersection island with smoothly flowing traffic, smart traffic lights glowing teal, a small electric bus, little cars, glowing teal route lines painted on the road guiding the vehicles, a tiny navigation pin balloon floating above
sections.focal: the intersection with the glowing route lines
sections.title: Rute terbaik, tanpa menebak.
sections.body: Navigasi berbasis data membaca kondisi jalan secara real time dan mencarikan jalan yang paling masuk akal.

sections.label: Belanja
sections.subject: a miniature smart kitchen and pantry island: an open fridge restocking itself with vegetables, a small delivery drone landing a grocery box on the balcony, a robot arm placing fruit into a woven basket, a tablet on the wall showing a shopping list made of food icons
sections.focal: the drone landing the grocery box
sections.title: Stok habis? Sudah dipesan.
sections.body: Daftar belanja tersusun dari kebiasaanmu, pesanan berangkat sendiri, dan kurir datang saat kamu ada di rumah.

sections.label: Kreativitas
sections.subject: a miniature creative studio island: an easel with a colorful abstract painting, a small music keyboard, a camera on a tripod, a small friendly robot holding a paintbrush next to a faceless toy figurine, colorful floating picture tiles and sticky notes
sections.focal: the easel where the robot and figurine paint together
sections.title: Ide jadi draf dalam menit.
sections.body: AI membantu dari coretan kasar ke draf pertama, sementara selera dan keputusan akhir tetap milikmu.

sections.label: Layanan
sections.subject: a miniature customer support center island: a cozy help desk with headsets, a friendly robot agent at a counter answering many floating empty speech bubbles at once, a queue of tiny parcels with smiley tags, a glowing teal moon and a warm sun hanging above
sections.focal: the robot agent answering speech bubbles
sections.title: Buka 24 jam, tetap ramah.
sections.body: Chatbot menjawab pertanyaan berulang seketika, dan kasus rumit diteruskan ke tim manusia lengkap dengan konteksnya.

sections.label: Pemasaran
sections.subject: a miniature marketing studio island: a giant coral clay megaphone, small billboards and phone screens showing colorful picture tiles, a robot placing content cards onto a conveyor belt that sends them out, a rising arrow sculpture in teal
sections.focal: the giant megaphone and the content conveyor
sections.title: Konten jalan, kamu pegang strategi.
sections.body: Penjadwalan posting, uji iklan, dan laporan performa diurus otomatis, jadi tim punya waktu untuk ide yang benar-benar baru.

sections.label: Penjualan
sections.subject: a miniature sales office island with a large glowing teal funnel sculpture, small colored cards flowing down through the funnel and sorted into trays by a robot, a statue of two faceless toy figurines shaking hands, a ringing desk phone
sections.focal: the glowing funnel with cards flowing through it
sections.title: Tidak ada lead yang terlupa.
sections.body: CRM otomatis memberi skor, mengirim follow-up, dan mengingatkan sales tepat saat calon pembeli sedang hangat.

sections.label: Gudang
sections.subject: a miniature automated warehouse island: tall shelves full of cardboard boxes, small orange and teal mobile robots carrying shelves around, a robotic arm picking items into boxes, a glowing scanner gate, neat stacks of parcels
sections.focal: the robotic arm and the mobile robots between the shelves
sections.title: Stok akurat tanpa hitung manual.
sections.body: Sensor dan sistem inventori mencatat setiap barang masuk dan keluar, lalu memberi sinyal sebelum stok menipis.

sections.label: Produksi
sections.subject: a miniature smart factory island: a production line with robotic arms assembling small products, a camera on a stand inspecting items with a teal scan beam, a small robot dropping one faulty item into a coral bin, gears and pipes around
sections.focal: the camera scanning products on the line
sections.title: Cacat ketahuan sebelum dikirim.
sections.body: Computer vision memeriksa produk di lini, dan perawatan mesin dijadwalkan sebelum mesinnya sempat rusak.

sections.label: Logistik
sections.subject: a miniature logistics hub island: delivery vans and a truck leaving a depot, glowing teal route lines curving across a little road network like a map, map pins, a drone carrying a parcel, a loading dock with small robots
sections.focal: the depot where the vans leave along the glowing routes
sections.title: Rute paling efisien, setiap hari.
sections.body: Algoritma menyusun urutan pengantaran dan memantau armada, sehingga waktu dan bensin tidak terbuang di jalan.

sections.label: Pembukuan
sections.subject: a miniature accounting office island: a robot feeding paper receipts into a glowing scanner machine that outputs neat blue folders, a big clay calculator, a balanced scale statue, tidy stacks of paper invoices, a small safe
sections.focal: the scanner machine turning receipts into folders
sections.title: Pembukuan yang rapi sendiri.
sections.body: Struk dipindai, transaksi dicocokkan otomatis, dan laporan bulanan siap tanpa lembur di akhir bulan.

sections.label: SDM
sections.subject: a miniature HR and recruiting office island: a sorting machine matching blank profile cards to open desk slots, a welcome desk with a wrapped gift box, a faceless toy figurine being greeted by a small robot, a small training room with a glowing screen
sections.focal: the welcome desk where the robot greets the new figurine
sections.title: Rekrut cepat, onboarding mulus.
sections.body: AI membantu menyaring lamaran sesuai kriteria, dan karyawan baru langsung mendapat akses, materi, dan jadwal di hari pertama.

sections.label: Data
sections.subject: a miniature data center and control room island: rows of glowing server racks with teal lights, a big curved dashboard screen with colorful abstract charts, a small robot analyst holding a magnifying glass, streams of light particles flowing between the servers
sections.focal: the curved dashboard screen and the robot analyst
sections.title: Keputusan dari data, bukan feeling.
sections.body: Dashboard yang memperbarui diri merangkum penjualan, biaya, dan tren, lengkap dengan peringatan saat ada yang janggal.

sections.label: Workflow
sections.subject: a miniature automation plant island: colorful clay pipes and conveyor belts connecting several small app-shaped buildings, glowing teal cubes traveling through the transparent pipes, big gears turning, a small robot operator at a control lever
sections.focal: the glowing cubes traveling through the pipes
sections.title: Aplikasi saling bicara sendiri.
sections.body: Form, CRM, spreadsheet, dan chat tersambung dalam satu alur, jadi data tidak perlu lagi dipindah manual satu per satu.

sections.label: Keamanan
sections.subject: a miniature cybersecurity fortress island: a glowing teal shield dome over a small server building, a round vault door, a robot guard with a flashlight on patrol, a big padlock sculpture, small coral arrows bouncing off the shield
sections.focal: the glowing shield dome over the server building
sections.title: Penjaga yang tidak pernah tidur.
sections.body: Sistem pemantau mendeteksi login aneh dan pola serangan lebih awal, lalu menutup celah sebelum jadi masalah.

sections.label: UMKM
sections.subject: a miniature Indonesian street shop island: a small warung kiosk with a striped coral and white awning, a tablet point-of-sale and a card payment terminal on the counter, a delivery scooter parked in front, a small robot stacking snack jars, warm string lights
sections.focal: the warung counter with the tablet point-of-sale
sections.title: Warung kecil, sistem kelas kakap.
sections.body: Kasir digital, stok otomatis, dan pesanan online membuat usaha kecil bisa bekerja serapi perusahaan besar.

sections.label: Kolaborasi
sections.subject: a single oversized glowing AI core: a big rounded clay sphere with a soft teal light inside, floating above a small round island, with small props orbiting around it: a tiny house, a shopping bag, a gear, a bar chart, an envelope, a delivery box and a heart. A faceless toy figurine and a small robot stand together on the island giving each other a high five
sections.focal: the glowing AI core sphere
sections.title: Manusia + AI, tim terbaik.
sections.body: Automation mengambil alih pekerjaan berulang supaya kamu punya waktu untuk berpikir, mencipta, dan menikmati hidup.
